name: pnp-spfx-copilot-recipe-agent
title: Recipe Kitchen Agent - Find recipes to cook from Copilot chat
shortDescription: Discover and view recipes directly from Copilot chat.
longDescription: Recipe Kitchen Agent helps you find recipes by dish name directly from Copilot chat. Select a result to view source-linked ingredients and instructions with interactive checklists. Ingredient, cuisine, time, and dietary filters are not supported.

Built with a SharePoint Copilot App (SPFx 1.24.0, @microsoft/sp-copilot-component), RecipeSearchCopilotComponent supports inline and fullscreen views. The default provider retrieves recipes from TheMealDB; a deterministic mock provider is available for local debugging.
